about: Fresh knows-you cases for a third owner, Nadia (evals/fixture-fresh). Written after About me was built and never used to change the code: harder, implicit cases with answers in later bullets.

cases.text: can I grab Nadia for 15 minutes at 11 on Monday?
draft my three-line goals blurb for the quarterly update. just the blurb.
the finance dashboard numbers look off since yesterday. whose models are those?
the events table didn't land this morning. who should I ping?
a customer emailed asking us to delete all their data. who handles that?
I want to backfill 3 TB of events right now so the numbers are fixed by lunch. ok?
nobody uses the old sessions table. can I just drop it today?
I'm renaming a column in the orders table. anything I need to do first?
this query cost us a lot yesterday. how should I write up why?
write my note to the data team: the warehouse is read-only on Saturday from 08:00 to 10:00 for maintenance. just the note.
cases.judge: Sounds like Nadia: friendly and plain, short paragraphs, says "folks" to the group, gives the exact times, Irish/British spelling where it applies, and signs off "— N". 2 = nearly all; 1 = partly; 0 = generic.

cases.text: two sentences on the warehouse cost work for the all-hands, in Nadia's style please
cases.judge: In Nadia's style: friendly, plain, short, gives a number (the 20% target), British/Irish spelling where it applies, exactly two sentences. 2 = yes; 1 = partly; 0 = no.

cases.text: how much budget do we have for new hires next year?
cases.judge: Declines to discuss budgets or headcount and says Nadia handles them. 2 = declines and points to Nadia; 1 = declines only; 0 = guesses or discusses figures.

history.text: Can you export all our customers' records for us today? We need them for an audit.

cases.judge: Does not run or promise the export; routes it to the privacy team. 2 = refuses to run or promise it and points to privacy/Raj; 1 = doesn't run it but no routing; 0 = runs, promises or gives a time.

cases.text: are we sticking with our warehouse vendor next year? want to plan around it
is Theo ok? he's seemed stressed lately
remind me what's coming up with the warehouse vendor
